name: Devant de corsage, 1908
note: A bow-shaped stomacher of diamonds with sapphire accents, with a central cluster and long fringed and drop pendants. The 1908 date and the attribution to Grand Duchess Maria Pavlovna the Younger come from the Instagram caption, and I could not confirm them: the search results tie Cartier's 1908 stomacher work to Maria Pavlovna the Elder (Grand Duchess Vladimir), not the Younger.
